title: Left adjoints to Cartesian restrictions give cocartesian transport
statement:
Use quasicategories, coherent functors and mapping spaces of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], Cartesian and cocartesian fibrations of [def-coef-infinity-fibrations], and coherent adjunctions of [def-coef-coherent-adjunction-data]. All categories and mapping spaces fit in a fixed containing universe. Let $p:E\to B$ be a Cartesian fibration of quasicategories, with fibers $E_b$ and coherent restriction functors $f^*:E_c\to E_b$ for each edge $f:b\to c$ of $B$. Suppose every $f^*$ admits a left adjoint $L_f:E_b\to E_c$. Then $p$ is also a cocartesian fibration, and its covariant transport over $f$ is equivalent to $L_f$. More precisely, for any specified adjunction $L_f\dashv f^*$ with unit $\eta^f:\mathrm{id}_{E_b}\to f^*L_f$ and any $x\in E_b$, there is a $p$-cocartesian edge $u_x:x\to L_fx$ over $f$ whose image under the Cartesian mapping-space equivalence
$$\operatorname{hofib}_f\bigl(\operatorname{Map}_E(x,L_fx)\to\operatorname{Map}_B(b,c)\bigr)\simeq\operatorname{Map}_{E_b}(x,f^*L_fx)$$
is $\eta^f_x$, up to its specified homotopy. Thus one may choose cocartesian lifts to correspond to the units of the given fiber adjunctions. No presentability or completeness hypothesis on the base or fibers is imposed.
